🧩 Product / Workflow
Workflow Change · Salesforce

New Sales → IMP Calendly Meeting Handoff in Salesforce

Sales has a cleaner handoff path for booking with the Implementation team from the PMT project. The goal is simple: keep the opportunity, implementation project, and Calendly handoff tied together inside Salesforce instead of relying on one-off scheduling steps.

▶ Watch: New Sales → IMP Calendly Meeting Hand Off Process in SF
✅
What sales needs to know: When an opportunity is ready for Implementation, use the Salesforce handoff flow from the opportunity / PMT project path to initiate implementation and book the Implementation Calendly.
🔗
Why it’s changing: The handoff needs to stay connected to the Salesforce opportunity and implementation project so Implementation has the right context and Sales has a cleaner record of what was booked.
🛠️
How it impacts your day-to-day: Don’t book eligible Implementation handoffs as a standalone calendar step. Start from the opportunity, use the Initiate Implementation flow, complete the required handoff fields, and follow the Loom walkthrough for the Calendly booking motion.
Rep action: For New Sales → IMP handoffs, use the Salesforce / PMT workflow first, then book through the approved Implementation Calendly path. Open the Loom walkthrough.
Internal Admin Feature

Brand Tag Rollout — Franchise Company Grouping in Admin

Brand Tag gives teams a reliable way to group companies by franchise brand in Homebase admin. It adds a brand-level sorting layer so Sales, CX, and data teams don’t have to rely on inconsistent company-name searches.

▶ Watch: How to Manage Brand Tags in Homebase
🏷️
What sales needs to know: Companies can now be tagged to a parent franchise brand. The new Businesses → Brand Tags tab shows every tag with company counts, and the company index can be filtered by brand tag.
🧭
Why it’s happening: Franchise accounts need a cleaner grouping layer across CX, Sales, and data. Brand Tag replaces unreliable company-name filtering with a consistent company-level tag.
✍️
How it impacts your day-to-day: When you notice a franchise company missing its brand, add the brand tag from the company edit form. No bulk clean-up is required. New brand creation still sits with Engineering / the Franchise team.
Known limitation: Brand Tag is company-level, not location-level. Multi-unit, multi-brand operators should not be tagged if it would create an inaccurate brand association. Open the Loom walkthrough.
⚙️ CS Ops / Payroll
Small Copy Fix · Payroll NSF

NSF Wire Deadline Copy Now Reflects Check Wire Windows

The Payroll NSF “Wire funds” guidance now shows Check’s actual wire received-by windows in the company’s location timezone, instead of showing ACH submission deadlines.

NSF resolution modal — localized Check wire windows
💸
What sales needs to know: Payroll customers in the NSF flow now see wire cutoff language based on Check’s wire windows, converted to their location timezone.
🧾
Why it changed: The old copy could show an ACH deadline, which confused customers when the NSF email arrived after that displayed time.
📣
How it impacts your day-to-day: If a customer asks about NSF wire timing, explain that the product reflects Check wire cutoffs in their local timezone. SMS and push remain generic and still point customers back to Homebase.
Wire-window logic: Received by 5pm ET the day before payday → team paid by 8:30am ET on payday. Received by 4pm ET on payday → team paid by 6pm ET on payday, converted into the company’s timezone.
